limits: Provided manifest agreement is not semantic log quality validation.
DuckDB type inference and NULL conventions need explicit field contracts before downstream analysis.
CREATE OR REPLACE intentionally replaces the seven named tables on a successful run; use a dedicated database.
Connection errors share a rollback label even if no connection/transaction was established; nonzero exit behavior is correct.
No applicant local execution or authorship observation is inferred from Codex test results.
This is the second implementation module, not completion of UI/deployment or the full project.
